description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to reduce global threats to maritime security and cybersecurity. The action will thus support the implementation of the revised EU Maritime Security Strategy (2023), the EU Cybersecurity Strategy for Digital Decade (2020) and the EU Strategy for Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific (2021). Component 1 ¿ CRIMARIO: This has been for years the EU¿s flagship security initiative for Indo-Pacific. The specific objective of this component is to strengthen maritime security and safety and the fight against IUU fishing. This component would lead to the third phase of the project. CRIMARIO III will consolidate the position in the Indo-Pacific by further strengthening its capacity building, especially through the IORIS platform, and will offer this cooperation also to other countries in the Latin America and the Caribbean, with a view to ensuring the platform¿s credibility, long-term use, and related sustainability.Component 2 ¿ EU CyberNet Plus: The specific objective of this Component is to further strengthen cyber capacity globally through international cooperation. This Component will ensure an extension of the EU CyberNet project beyond 2026, including its ability to act globally on request from EU institutions and in complementarity to other EU actions.Component 3 ¿ Global Forum on Cyber Expertise (GFCE): Considering the unique role played by the GFCE in enhancing coordination and cohesion of the international donors and implementors in cyber capacity building, this Component will provide funding support to the GFCE. The specific objective of this Component is also to strengthen cyber capacity globally through international cooperation.All Components will be implemented in full complementarity and cooperation with country and regional programmes as well as with Common Security and Defence Policy (CSDP) Missions and Operations, where relevant, and in coordination with EU Delegations, EEAS, DG INTPA and NEAR. Cooperation with Horizon Europe projects will be explored.
